Using \(t\) hours after midnight, the activity is \(T\) on \([0,12)\) and \(S\) on \([12,24)\).  
The poster is true iff \(A(t-2 \bmod 24)=A(t+1 \bmod 24)\).

Split at \(t=2,11,14,23\):

- \(0\le t<2\): \(t-2\in[22,24)=S\), \(t+1\in[1,3)=T\) → false
- \(2\le t<11\): both \(T\) → true, length \(9\)
- \(11\le t<14\): \(T\) vs \(S\) → false
- \(14\le t<23\): both \(S\) → true, length \(9\)
- \(23\le t<24\): \(S\) vs \(T\) → false

Total truth time: \(9+9=18\) hours.

\[
\boxed{18}
\]
